newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain ICO to issue up to 210 bln ptas debt in '97.
newsitem.headline: Spain ICO to issue up to 210 bln ptas debt in '97.

text.p: Spain's Official Credit Institute (ICO) said on Wednesday it would issue a total of up to 210 billion pesetas' worth of bonds and notes in 1997.
ICO said it will issue an initial amount of up to 105 billion pesetas' debt, extendable to 210 billion.
A first auction will take place on February 10.
The debt will be issued in three separate tranches for a nominal 35 billion pesetas, which can be increased up to 70 billion.

Bonds and notes will each have a face value of 10,000 pesetas and a maturity of three, five and 10 years. Nominal interest paid will be 6.50 percent, with return determined by the price at which the debt is issued.
